Called from the per-frame vehicle physics time step.

operations.description: Copy 0x24 bytes (nine floats) of the rotation matrix from a2 into this+0x34B0..0x34D0 (offsets 13488 onward, R).
Store input vector components from a3: a3[0] to this+0x3534, a3[1] to this+0x3538, a3[2] to this+0x353C (offsets 13620/13624/13628).
Output X at this+0x3540 = this[0x34B0]*this[0x3534] + this[0x34B4]*this[0x3538] + this[0x34B8]*this[0x353C] (first matrix row dotted with the input vector).
Output Y at this+0x3544 = this[0x34BC]*this[0x3534] + this[0x34C0]*this[0x3538] + this[0x34C4]*this[0x353C] (second matrix row dotted with the input vector).

Return a pointer to the copied rotation matrix (this + 13488, i.e. this+0x34B0).
